referenceFunction.generalComment: Production of a ventilation system for a residential care home with apartments, kitchen, cafe/restaurant, multi-purpose hall, wellness area and laundry. The inventory is based on a building with a total heated gross floor area of 9844 m2 and a total nominal air flow of 34460 m3/h, total weight of the components: 11910 kg/Unit, building with a specific air flow rate of 3.5 m3/h per m2 heated gross floor area. Data from call of bid including components for air handling units, ducts including insulation, air valves, roof-hoods, dampers, fire dampers, silencers. The data represent a ductwork mainly made of galvanized steel and includes air handling units mainly with heat recovery. System with central air handling units. Building without ground heat exchanger.; UUID: 4c28c29d-c72a-3761-b969-324418f65ad4
